name: Customer Dining Order Flow & Item Customization

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app with table parameter '?table=01' to simulate customer scanning table QR code
The header displays the store logo, store name, and Table 01 badge indicator
Click on category filter tabs (Coffee, Food, Dessert) and type 'Americano' in the search bar
Menu grid updates to show matching items with clear photos, price in THB, and tags
Click on 'Iced Americano' or first coffee item to open the Item Detail Modal
Item modal displays price, image, sweetness levels, size radio buttons, and special notes textarea
Select 'หวานน้อย 25%' (Low Sweetness 25%), add note 'ไม่หวานมาก', and click 'เพิ่มลงตะกร้า' (Add to Cart)
Item modal closes and the floating cart badge in bottom bar increments to show 1 item
Click on the floating cart bar to open the Cart Drawer
Cart Drawer displays selected item, chosen customizations, subtotal, and Dining Type selector
Select payment method 'เงินสด (Cash at Counter)' and click 'ยืนยันสั่งอาหาร' (Confirm Order)
Order Countdown Modal appears showing order summary and starts 3-second countdown before finalizing
Order Tracker Sheet opens showing active status 'รอดำเนินการ (Pending)', order number, and table number
